map.→ 打开最佳轮次选择工具: -> Open the optimal round selection tool
map.取平滑后的最优且要求持续优势(patience)，避免单点噪声误导；也可在最佳轮: Take the smoothed best epoch and require a sustained margin (patience) to avoid being misled by single-point noise; you can also run a few extra validations near the best epoch to confirm stability.
map.取验证损失最低的轮次而非最后一轮，是早停的标准做法。若多个轮次损失接近，优先选更: Taking the epoch with the lowest validation loss rather than the last is the standard early-stopping practice. If several epochs have close losses, prefer the later one (usually more stable) or filter again by a secondary metric (F1); note that selecting epochs on the validation set is itself mildly optimistic, so a strict evaluation should hold out an independent test set.
map.在记录中各轮验证指标(如验证 loss/F1)取最优轮次，作为部署权重。: Pick the best epoch by validation metrics (such as validation loss or F1) in the log and use it as the deployed weights.
map.最佳轮次 = argmin(验证损失)；最小验证损失 = min(l₁…l₅): Best epoch = argmin(validation loss); minimum validation loss = min(l1...l5)
map.用 loss 还是 F1 选最佳轮？: Use loss or F1 to pick the best epoch?
map.监控指标上升即早停，并回退到最佳轮 checkpoint，避免用过拟合权重。: Stop early as soon as the monitored metric rises and roll back to the best epoch checkpoint, avoiding overfitted weights.
map.看目标。回归用验证 loss/RMSE；分类常看 F1/Accuracy；若关注: Match the goal. Regression uses validation loss/RMSE; classification often uses F1/accuracy; if false positives matter, look at precision. The primary metric should map directly to business value.
map.若多指标冲突(如 loss 最低但 F1 非最高)，按业务优先级选定主指标。: If several metrics conflict (such as lowest loss but not highest F1), pick the primary metric by business priority.
map.输入各训练轮次的验证指标，自动选出最优轮次并给出早停建议，适用于模型 check: Enter validation metrics for each training epoch to auto-select the best epoch and give an early-stopping suggestion, useful for checkpoint selection, training review and deployed weight selection.
map.验证指标波动怎么选？: How to choose when validation metrics fluctuate?
map.：10 轮验证 F1 为 [0.80,0.83,0.85,0.86,0.87,0: : validation F1 over 10 epochs is [0.80,0.83,0.85,0.86,0.87,0.87,0.86,0.85,0.84,0.83]; the best is epoch 6 at 0.87, so load the epoch 6 weights rather than the last epoch.
